question: In the CO2-WAG stacking-learning study, which of the three base proxy models had the lowest MSE over the whole data bank, and how many hidden layers and neurons does it have?
rendered: The third base model, which uses the Softmax transfer function, has the lowest MSE over the whole data bank. It has three hidden layers with 28 neurons in the first layer and 10 neurons in the second layer.
